thread:
leah: Quick idea — run a split test for private offers on Azure + GCP marketplaces: test 3 discount slabs + two renewal-cadence triggers. Thoughts?

omar: 👍 good. propose cohorts by deal size: < $20k, $20k–200k, > $200k. Also include dedicated vs hosted SKUs?

sudeep: Add hardware partner variant — include an 'on-prem appliance' SKU to measure lift. Keep metering & feature parity identical across cohorts.

anna: Agree. Primary metrics: 90-day commit conversion and 12‑month renewal rate. Secondary: ARR uplift and sales cycle reduction.

leah: Success criteria idea: +15% commit conversion in 90d OR +8% ARR uplift vs baseline. If neither is hit we roll back the higher discounts.

david: Ops Q: who owns private-offer creation/approval? marketplace-bot can stage offers but legal must sign off for >25% discount.

marketplace-bot: FYI I can stage offers in sandbox catalogs. Command to use: `/mp create-test-offer --cloud gcp --sku "dedicated-basic" --discount 15 --cohort mid`

omar: Timeline suggestion: prep by EOW, run 8 weeks live, 2 weeks analysis. Need partner comms for hardware partners — @sudeep can you lead that?

sudeep: On it. Drafting partner note + SI incentive: 3% referral credit on committed spend for first renewal. Will share draft tomorrow.

anna: Also coordinate with Sales Ops to tag test leads and add renewal nudges at month 10 for deals > $200k.

leah: I'll sync with Legal on discount thresholds and with Product Marketing for messaging. If everyone ok I'll create the Asana task + kickoff doc.

omar: :thumbsup: pls include region tags (us-west / us-east / eu) — pricing elasticity differs regionally. Also recommend sampling smaller SI partners to avoid bias.

leah: Good call. We'll split SIs into strategic vs transactional and randomize across cohorts. I'll post Asana link when created.

anna: One more ask — can we capture attribution for channel (marketplace vs direct sales) so we can compare CAC?

david: Sales Ops will add attribution tag. Also flagging billing edge-cases for appliance SKUs (invoiced vs metered).

leah: Perfect. Next steps: Sudeep partner note, Omar orchestration plan, Anna metrics dashboard spec, David Sales Ops gating, me legal/message sync. Back here with Asana link by Friday.

omar: Great — thanks all. Let’s keep the test narrow and measurable.
